answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 36108 Country: India Title: I have interest money with me, lying in my SB account [this is not fixed deposit but interest received on SB account given by the bank without my demand Question: I have interest money with me, lying in my SB account [this is not fixed deposit but interest received on SB account given by the bank without my demand. Can I use this money to pay my income tax? NOTE: I am also paying my zakah out of my halal earnings. Answer ID: 36108 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 164/164/M=1433) It is allowable to pay income tax with the interest money received from government bank. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
